messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: kv-cache eviction-spike detected in us-east-1 (pool=kv-main). 5m eviction rate=32%, hit-rate falling to 61%. Downstream p95 request latency up ~210ms. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/kv-cache?panel=evictions&var-region=us-east-1

Maya (oncall): I'm on it. Acknowledge pager and starting live triage.

Jared: joining. Do we have any infra or deploys that could explain this?

Priya: no infra deploys touching cache in the last 4h. I see a spike in churn from tenant "integration-loadtest" sending many ephemeral keys. Their job started ~12:09 UTC.

Anika: confirmed. The job creates per-request keys with short TTLs; churn metric top prefixes show mostly /tmp/int-*. This is trashing the LRU and causing churn.

Maya (oncall): immediate mitigations we can do: A) scale cache pool by adding capacity, B) apply temporary tenant-level write-throttle for integration-loadtest, C) enable short-term LFU policy to favor longer-lived keys, D) direct heavy tenants to cold-read path. Which is fastest?

Jared: scaling is fastest. I'll kick a scale by +5 nodes for the pool. Priya, can you gate that tenant?

Priya: applying tenant throttle via quota-service:

```bash
# throttle job for integration-loadtest to 10rps
./tools/tenant-quota set --tenant integration-loadtest --rate 10
```

OpsBot: Run executed: scale_pool --region us-east-1 --pool kv-main --add-nodes 5 (initiated by @Jared)

Jared: scale command output: new nodes provisioning, expected warmup ~60-120s. Watching cache fill metrics.

Anika: hit-rate recovering slowly, eviction rate trending down from 32% -> 18% in 2m.

incident-bot: Update: eviction 18% (2m), hit-rate 70%, downstream p95 latency improving.

Maya (oncall): good. In parallel I'll flip a policy toggle to LFU favoring longer-lived keys for 30m window to protect hot keys. Priya, any config concerns?

Priya: LFU toggle exists but we need to bump small-key-ttl to 45m to prevent rapid eviction of bursty small items. Pushing change now.

OpsBot: Config push: kv.policy.eviction=LFU_TEMP, kv.small_key_ttl=45m -> success. Proxy rolling restart scheduled gracefully.

Anika: proxies restarted, caches warming. Hit-rate now 82%, eviction 6% stable.

Maya (oncall): marking active mitigations complete. Noting customer impact: Support shows ~12 customers saw elevated latency, 3 had transient 502s and auto-retries succeeded. CS ticket filed: CS-2078 (alpha-inc reports higher request cost due to fallback path).

Jared: pinged CS with context. We'll review billing impact.

Maya (oncall): incident summary for channel: root cause: noisy integration-loadtest causing short-lived key churn -> eviction spike -> hit-rate drop -> downstream latency/503s. Mitigations applied: scaled pool +5 nodes, throttled tenant, temporary LFU+TTL increase, restarted proxies. Stable state reached ~+14m.

incident-bot: Suggested post-incident work: 1) tune alert thresholds, 2) add per-tenant churn and hit-rate panels, 3) create a runbook entry for eviction spikes, 4) add mute rules for low-volume pools.

Maya (oncall): agreed. Assignments:
- Jared: update alerting rules and implement composite alert (eviction+hitrate) and severity tiers.
- Priya: add per-tenant breakdown panels and a heatmap for churn on kv-cache dashboard.
- Anika: draft runbook steps for detecting burst-churn and automated tenant throttling.
- Maya: write blameless postmortem and customer impact summary for CS.

Jared: proposed alert change: keep pager only for (eviction >30% for 10m) OR (hit-rate <65% for 5m). Add a lower-severity slack-only alert for eviction 20-30%. Also add composite alert: eviction>15% AND churn_rate_top5 > 50% to reduce false positives. Thoughts?

Priya: +1 to severity tiers and composite alert. Please ensure we exclude tiny pools (volume < 100 QPS) from pagers.

Anika: for dashboards I'll add a column showing top tenant contributors and prefix-sample so we can triage fast. Also adding a panel that computes 'eviction-cost' = eviction_rate * token-rate to quantify bill impact.

Maya (oncall): timeline: pager at first_message_ts, scale + throttle applied by +5m, policy toggle by +8m, stable by +14m. Handing follow-up to Jared for alert changes and to Priya/Anika for dashboards/runbook. I'll loop CS on next steps.

Jared: creating ALERT-3992 to update thresholds and ALERT-3993 for composite rule.

Priya: creating DASH-880 (per-tenant panels) and linking to incident.

Anika: runbook PR in progress, will include playbook steps and automation to auto-throttle noisy tenants for short windows.

OpsBot: Tasks created: TASK-1301 (alert tuning) -> Jared, TASK-1302 (dashboard panels) -> Priya, TASK-1303 (runbook churn detect) -> Anika, TASK-1304 (postmortem writeup) -> Maya.

Maya (oncall): handing off to @Jared for overnight watch on alert changes. If anything regresses DM me. Good work team. :clap:

Jared: taking overnight. Will push alert changes in a canary and monitor.

Priya: following up with CS on the 3 customers with 502s and attaching request traces.

Anika: PR for dashboard and runbook in ~45m.

Maya (oncall): closing thread. Postmortem link will be posted in #incidents when ready.
